# Stario

Stario is a Python framework for server-rendered hypermedia apps. Handlers are async functions that write HTML through a `Writer`. Routes are explicit `Route` values. Datastar morphs the page in the browser. A long-lived SSE stream keeps a page live. State lives on the server. Stario is not ASGI; run it with `python -m app.main`, or `just dev` / `uv run watchfiles 'python -m app.main' app/ static/` in development.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://stario.dev/AGENTS.md): the app guide, enough for a first page. Copy it into every Stario repo: the loop, the imports, a live page with paging, commands, names, rules.
- [stario-create](https://github.com/stariodev/stario-create): `uvx stario-create new my-app --db` creates a runnable app with the guide, the skills, and a `justfile`.
- [llms-full.txt](https://stario.dev/llms-full.txt): the guide and the skills in one file, for tools that want more context.
- [The Stario way](https://stario.dev/docs/explanation/the-stario-way): why Stario is shaped this way.

## Skills (loaded when their topic comes up)

- [stario-api](https://stario.dev/skills/stario-api/SKILL.md): Stario server names beyond AGENTS.md - settings, cookies, forms and uploads, static files that keep their name, error pages, redirects, middleware. Use when AGENTS.md lacks a server name or pyrefly rejects one.
- [stario-auth](https://stario.dev/skills/stario-auth/SKILL.md): Accounts in a Stario app - password sign-up and sign-in (add auth --password), Google or GitHub sign-in (add auth), logout, protected pages, rows per user, API tokens. Use for any login or permission need.
- [stario-browser-check](https://stario.dev/skills/stario-browser-check/SKILL.md): Load before a browser, a screenshot, Playwright, or computer use on a Stario app - the test that answers each question without a browser, and the two cases where a browser is right. Not for the task's own acceptance suite.
- [stario-client](https://stario.dev/skills/stario-client/SKILL.md): JavaScript in a Stario app - where it goes and how Python calls it. Use before any script, addEventListener, long data.on expression, drag, picker, or clipboard. Not for what a GET or a data.* attribute does.
- [stario-datastar](https://stario.dev/skills/stario-datastar/SKILL.md): Every Stario page-side option - h.* tags and node types, @baked, trusted HTML and Markdown, data.* attributes, at.* actions, SSE methods, morphs. Use when AGENTS.md lacks one or pyrefly rejects a node.
- [stario-feature](https://stario.dev/skills/stario-feature/SKILL.md): Tests for a Stario page (TestClient calls, a stream, two tabs, bad input) and page extras - go to the page a command made, a live navbar count, several tables, removing a page. Use when writing tests or one of these.
- [stario-jobs](https://stario.dev/skills/stario-jobs/SKILL.md): Slow work in a Stario app (a report, a model call, an import) as a job with live progress and clean shutdown, and a loop on a timer. Use when a command starts work that takes seconds, or work runs on a schedule.
- [stario-litewriter](https://stario.dev/skills/stario-litewriter/SKILL.md): Change a SQLite table that already holds rows - a new column with its old rows filled, indexes, JSON columns, how watch wakes. Use when a filled database changes shape or a watch does not repaint. Not for a new table (AGENTS.md).
- [stario-outside-api](https://stario.dev/skills/stario-outside-api/SKILL.md): Call an outside HTTP API from a Stario app - an httpx client opened in bootstrap, a cache, a 404 page, tests that fake the API. Use when pages read data from another service over HTTP.
- [stario-relay](https://stario.dev/skills/stario-relay/SKILL.md): A live Stario page on state in memory (Relay), a message to one tab, an edit dialog that keeps what the user typed. Use when state is in memory, or any page needs an edit dialog or a message to one tab.
- [stario-tailwind-daisyui](https://stario.dev/skills/stario-tailwind-daisyui/SKILL.md): Tailwind CSS v4 and DaisyUI for a Stario app (stario-create add tailwind, no Node), with a light and dark theme. Use when the app is styled with Tailwind or DaisyUI.
- [stario-view](https://stario.dev/skills/stario-view/SKILL.md): Sort, filter, or page a Stario list through the URL query, and search as you type that patches one part. Use when a list gets sort links, filters, paging, or a search box.

## Defaults in one paragraph

A page is a resource: the path names it, and the query holds the view (sort, filter, columns). Every route is in `app/urls.py`; the tables and every read and write are in `app/data.py`; each page is one file, `app/pages/<page>.py`, with one page class and its render functions. The class's fields are its dependencies, `register(app)` adds its routes, and each route is one method. A page whose state cannot change while it is open is one `GET`, plus private reads that patch one part. A live page is `GET /page`, `GET /page/live`, and `POST` commands that read, validate, write, and then reply. Only the stream sends HTML; a message for one tab goes through `Relay` on `tab.<id>`. The HTTP status is the reaction of the browser; the span is the outcome of the work. SQLite tables have plain columns; a table of `id` plus JSON is an option. Tests run through `TestClient(bootstrap)` and read the stream with `iter_events()`.
